request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn the plesiosaur into a chunky cute orca killer whale swimming at the surface: a fat round body low in the water, no long neck, a big round head with a friendly smile, a tall black dorsal fin, two paddle flippers and a tail fluke; glossy charcoal black back, cream-white belly and a white oval patch behind the eye; small ice-blue frost crystals on the fin tip. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, nothing under the body.
